rules.text: You can request a price match if the price goes lower at Target between November 1, 2026 and December 24, 2026 after purchase.
rules.quote: Starting November 1, 2026, if you purchase an item in store or online and the price goes lower at Target on or before December 24, 2026, you can request a price match.

rules.text: Price match requires the item to be identical in brand, size, weight, color, quantity, and model number.
rules.quote: The item must be identical in brand, size, weight, color, quantity and model number, and the lower price must be found at Target.com or in a local Target store.

rules.text: Price match excludes items purchased with a promotional Target GiftCard or items currently having a Target GiftCard promotion.
rules.quote: If you received a promotional Target GiftCard as part of the original purchase. Or, if the product currently has a Target GiftCard offered as part of a promotion.

rules.text: Produce items need to be sold in the same unit of measure (per pound vs. per item) for price match.
rules.quote: Items need to be sold in the same unit of measure (per pound vs. per item).

rules.text: Non-SuperTargets cannot match per-pound produce items.
Price match requires showing the price on your mobile device from Target.com; screenshots or pictures are not accepted.
rules.quote: Present the price on your mobile device from Target.com. A Target team member will then verify the match using a Target device. Screenshots or pictures cannot be accepted.
